# directory

GENERATE[OpenSSLConfigVersion.cmake]=exporters/cmake/OpenSSLConfigVersion.cmake.in

DEPEND[openssl.pc]=builddata.pm
DEPEND[openssl.pc]=libcrypto.pc libssl.pc
